description: This Java class, RoleDataValidator, is responsible for validating JSON data related to role creation and updates within the Apache Fineract system. It ensures required fields are present, limits are respected, and JSON input conforms to expected parameters before processing.

classes.name: RoleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for role data JSON payloads, providing validation methods for creating and updating role JSON data.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a new role, checking required fields and length constraints.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing role, allowing optional fields and enforcing constraints.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors are accumulated.
